# ARUL LOGIC

> ARUL LOGIC is an independent Android app studio from Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, India, founded by ARUL G. It makes simple, private apps for learning, focus, productivity and web developers. Slogan: Learn · Dream · Build.

All apps are on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/dev?id=7152012900864371035

## Apps
- [Webnix: Web DevTools Browser](https://arulg2005.github.io/arul_logic/webnix/): an Android browser with full web developer tools (inspect element, JavaScript console, network requests, Core Web Vitals, SEO audits, API mocking). No PC needed. More detail: https://arulg2005.github.io/arul_logic/webnix/llms.txt
- [Mom Says: Reminder & Focus](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.logicfirst.momsays): daily reminders, streaks and a gentle app blocker with a mother's voice, in English, Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, Malayalam and Kannada.
- [Numerix: Math Challenges](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.logicfirst.numerix): fun offline math challenges to train your brain.
- [Agenda: To-Do & Task Manager](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.logicfirst.agenda): a fast, distraction-free task manager.
- [GradeMap: CGPA Calculator](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.logicfirst.grademap): calculate CGPA and track grades.
- [ATS Score: Offline Tracker](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.logicfirst.atsscore): check how a resume scores with applicant tracking systems.
- [Math Talk](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.logicfirst.mathtalk): a talking calculator.
- [FitCalc](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.logicfirst.fitcalc): health calculators such as BMI.
- [LockMate](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.logicfirst.lockmate): lock apps to keep them private.
- [Sawcut Construction Calculator](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.arullogic.sawcut): exact feet-inch-fraction calculator with stairs, rafters, concrete, bricks and quotes; offline, no ads. Privacy: https://arulg2005.github.io/arul_logic/sawcut/privacy.html
- [Torchly](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.logicfirst.torchly): a simple flashlight.
